cosas.cosa: A mature broadleaf oak tree about 9 metres tall, made like a model-railway miniature tree: a thick gnarled bark-covered trunk with a slight lean, roots gripping the ground, a few strong branches, and a broad crown built from 6 to 9 large solid rounded clumps of foliage, like dense sculpted foam tufts with a fine leafy texture; no individual leaves, no thin twigs, no gaps of sky through the clumps.

A young slender broadleaf tree about 4 metres tall, made like a model-railway miniature tree: a thin straight trunk no thicker than a wrist, two or three short side branches, and a small crown of 3 to 5 solid rounded clumps of foliage like dense foam tufts with a fine leafy texture; no individual leaves or thin twigs.

A wild hazel bush about 1.4 metres tall, made like a model-railway miniature shrub: a few short woody stems at the base under 3 or 4 solid rounded clumps of green foliage, like dense foam tufts with a fine leafy texture; no individual leaves.

A low wild berry bush about 1.2 metres tall, made like a model-railway miniature shrub: one dense rounded mound of dark green foliage built from a few solid clumps, like foam tufts with a fine leafy texture, on short woody twigs at the base; no berries, no individual leaves.

A low thicket of wild scrub about 0.9 metres tall and 1.5 metres wide, made like a model-railway miniature: a low lumpy mound of solid clumps of olive-green and brownish foliage, like dense foam tufts, with a few short dry woody sticks poking out; no individual leaves or thin stems.

A medium weathered grey limestone boulder about 0.9 metres tall, irregular rounded blocky shape with a few cracks, pale grey stone with small lichen spots and a little green moss at its base; solid, no sand-coloured or brown stone.
